kalla.cp: adj. 1. clever; able 2. healthy; sound; 3. ready; 4. proper.
kalla.p: [Kala+la] (na) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 68. 331.] (1) dawn breaks time (or) Dawn time. (Ti) Suitable. (3) Capable. See - Kallitāparicita. (4) Healthy. See - Kallacitta-(2). (5) Tire. See - Kallakāya. (6) Skillful. (7) Should arrange. (8) A located place.
